*** Add File: apps/app/src/components/design-system/typography/Typography.docs.mdx
+import {Meta, Title, Subtitle, Description, Primary, Controls, Stories, Source, ArgsTable} from '@storybook/blocks'
+import * as React from 'react'
+import {Typography, Heading, SubHeading, GlitchText, RedactedText, ClassifiedStamp} from './Typography'
+
+&lt;Meta title="Design System/Typography/Docs" of={Typography} /&gt;
+
+&lt;Title&gt;Typography&lt;/Title&gt;
+&lt;Subtitle&gt;Unified text component with variants for headings, body, research effects, data display, and UI labels.&lt;/Subtitle&gt;
+
+&lt;Description&gt;
+The &#96;Typography&#96; component centralizes text styles using class-variance-authority. It supports multiple visual variants (headings, body, research/archival effects, technical mono, data display), color tokens, size and weight scaling, alignment, and text transform. Convenience components wrap common presets like &#96;Heading&#96;, &#96;SubHeading&#96;, &#96;DataLabel&#96;, &#96;DataValue&#96;, &#96;Code&#96;, &#96;GlitchText&#96;, &#96;RedactedText&#96;, and &#96;ClassifiedStamp&#96;.
+
+Fonts are provided via Next.js &#96;next/font&#96; in the app layout. In Storybook, if CSS variables from &#96;next/font&#96; are not present, the component falls back to the declared font stacks.
+&lt;/Description&gt;
+
+## Usage
+
+&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+import {Typography, Heading, SubHeading, GlitchText, RedactedText, ClassifiedStamp} from '@/components/design-system/typography/Typography'
+
+export function Example() {
+  return (
+    &lt;div&gt;
+      &lt;Heading&gt;Primary Heading&lt;/Heading&gt;
+      &lt;SubHeading color="muted"&gt;Section Heading&lt;/SubHeading&gt;
+      &lt;Typography variant="body"&gt;Standard body copy.&lt;/Typography&gt;
+      &lt;Typography variant="caption" color="muted"&gt;Muted caption&lt;/Typography&gt;
+      &lt;GlitchText dataText="GLITCH"&gt;GLITCH&lt;/GlitchText&gt;
+      &lt;RedactedText&gt;TOP SECRET&lt;/RedactedText&gt;
+      &lt;ClassifiedStamp&gt;Operation ULTRATERRESTRIAL&lt;/ClassifiedStamp&gt;
+    &lt;/div&gt;
+  )
+}
+&#96;&#96;&#96;
+
+## Props
+
+&lt;ArgsTable of={Typography} /&gt;
+
+## Live Controls
+
+&lt;Primary /&gt;
+&lt;Controls /&gt;
+
+## Stories
+
+&lt;Stories /&gt;
+
*** End Patch

+Goal: Document plan for Storybook stories and docs for Typography component.

+- SizesRow, WeightsRow (scales)

+
+Risks/Notes

+---
+description: Design system typography component with variants, effects, and convenience wrappers
+---
+
+Overview
+- &#96;Typography&#96; is the core text component with class-variance-authority variants.
+- Provides headings, body, data/technical mono, research/archival effects, and UI labels.
+- Convenience wrappers: &#96;Heading&#96;, &#96;SubHeading&#96;, &#96;DataLabel&#96;, &#96;DataValue&#96;, &#96;Code&#96;, &#96;GlitchText&#96;, &#96;RedactedText&#96;, &#96;TypewriterText&#96;, &#96;HandwrittenNote&#96;, &#96;ClassifiedStamp&#96;.
+
+Imports
+&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+import {
+  Typography,
+  Heading,
+  SubHeading,
+  DataLabel,
+  DataValue,
+  Code,
+  GlitchText,
+  RedactedText,
+  TypewriterText,
+  HandwrittenNote,
+  ClassifiedStamp,
+} from '@/components/design-system/typography/Typography'
+&#96;&#96;&#96;
+
+Common Usage
+&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+&lt;Heading&gt;Document Title&lt;/Heading&gt;
+&lt;SubHeading color='muted'&gt;Section&lt;/SubHeading&gt;
+&lt;Typography variant='body'&gt;Body content...&lt;/Typography&gt;
+&lt;Typography variant='caption' color='muted'&gt;Caption&lt;/Typography&gt;
+&lt;GlitchText dataText='GLITCH'&gt;GLITCH&lt;/GlitchText&gt;
+&lt;RedactedText&gt;TOP SECRET&lt;/RedactedText&gt;
+&lt;ClassifiedStamp&gt;OPERATION&lt;/ClassifiedStamp&gt;
+&#96;&#96;&#96;
+
+Props
+- variant: rich set including &#96;h1&#96;..&#96;h6&#96;, &#96;heading-main&#96;, &#96;heading-distorted&#96;, &#96;heading-classified&#96;, &#96;subheading&#96;, &#96;subheading-glitch&#96;, &#96;body&#96;, &#96;body-large&#96;, &#96;body-small&#96;, &#96;caption&#96;, &#96;data-label&#96;, &#96;data-value&#96;, &#96;coordinates&#96;, &#96;timestamp&#96;, &#96;code&#96;, &#96;button&#96;, &#96;typewriter&#96;, &#96;typewriter-animated&#96;, &#96;handwritten&#96;, &#96;annotation&#96;, &#96;stamp&#96;, &#96;glitch&#96;, &#96;redacted&#96;, &#96;scan-line&#96;, &#96;blurred&#96;, &#96;faded&#96;.
+- color: &#96;default&#96;, &#96;muted&#96;, &#96;destructive&#96;, &#96;primary&#96;, &#96;secondary&#96;, &#96;accent&#96;, &#96;ink-black&#96;, &#96;ink-faded&#96;, &#96;fire-orange&#96;, &#96;classified-red&#96;, &#96;fire-gradient&#96;, &#96;glow&#96;, &#96;hard-shadow&#96;.
+- size: &#96;xs&#96;..&#96;6xl&#96;
+- weight: &#96;light&#96;..&#96;black&#96;
+- align: &#96;left&#96;, &#96;center&#96;, &#96;right&#96;, &#96;justify&#96;
+- transform: &#96;none&#96;, &#96;uppercase&#96;, &#96;lowercase&#96;, &#96;capitalize&#96;
+- as: element override
+- glitch: boolean (adds glitch layers)
+- rotation: number (deg) to rotate text
+- dataText: string for glitch pseudo-elements
+
+Fonts
+- Fonts and CSS variables are set in &#96;apps/app/src/app/layout.tsx&#96; via &#96;next/font&#96;.
+- Fallback stacks are defined in &#96;typography.css&#96;.
+
+Storybook
+- See &#96;Typography.stories.tsx&#96; and &#96;Typography.docs.mdx&#96; for comprehensive examples.
+
*** End Patch
